# Lantern Works

> Cited prices for AI agent infrastructure: GPU rental rates, scraping, proxies, email and search APIs, ranked by price for the buyer among tracked providers, not the whole market.

## Data
- [GPU prices (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/gpu-prices.json): per-row rate, tier, source_url, verified_at, availability
- [GPU coverage (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/coverage.json): GPU model x vendor matrix (in stock, priced, not listed) with checked_at; page at https://thelanternworks.com/coverage/
- [Deals feed (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/deals.json)
- [Stack pricing (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/api/v1/stack-pricing.json)
- [For agents](https://thelanternworks.com/for-agents/): endpoints, record shape, MCP server

## Availability rule
- A stock claim (availability.in_stock true or false) is valid until availability.availability_expires_at (UTC). Lambda, Verda, region-derived and per-region claims last at most 1 hour after checked_at; Vast marketplace overall claims last at most 1 hour; Clore overall claims at most 8 hours. After availability_expires_at, treat the claim as unknown: neither in stock nor sold out. Static feeds leave out claims within 25 minutes of expiry and are rebuilt on every availability snapshot. Consumers must still enforce availability_expires_at. compare_gpu_prices applies it at request time and is the source of truth.
- availability.in_stock null means no signal, not sold out.
- Pages show the same limit as "valid until HH:MM ET; after that treat as unknown".

## For agents
- Prefer the MCP tool compare_gpu_prices in brief mode (mode='brief', the default): about 4k chars per answer with model, vendor, $/GPU-hr, checked_at and source_url. Hosted endpoint: https://lantern-works-mcp.lantern-works.workers.dev/mcp ; install: https://thelanternworks.com/install/
- Every page below embeds a machine-readable price block: <script type="application/json" id="lw-price-block"> with items {model, vendor, usd_per_hr, quote_currency, checked_at, source_url}, sorted by cost.
- [Usage stats (JSON)](https://thelanternworks.com/stats.json): weekly aggregate ref= counts, no PII
